messages:
sam: deploy-bot put release-candidate promote on HOLD — CI pipeline failing on remote-cache lease. deploy-bot: "cache-lease: acquire timeout for key=build-cache-rc-2026-03-23". blocking cut window, need decision: wait for cache recovery, rebuild, or pin previous artifact?

tess: I see the cache coordinator logs, there was a stuck writer thread on node-cache-7 holding lease >10m. other builds queue up and hit timeout.

ugo: rebuild would take ~18m and may miss the change window. pinning previous artifact avoids new work but we lose the intended changes in this RC. what's the policy?

vijay: given customer impact and change window, prefer pin to last-green so we don't delay rollout. we can schedule a hotfix PR and force a rebuild after cache eviction.

sam: agree pin if last-green is acceptable. we need to record in release notes and open INF-3120 for cache lease deadlock + owner.

deploy-bot: PROMOTE_HOLD: reason=cache-lease-timeout, candidate=rc-2026-03-23, last_green=rc-2026-03-22, triggered_by=ci-smoke. awaiting manual_approve from sam.

tess: also recommending immediate cache heal: kill stuck writer and run lease-recovery on node-cache-7 to unblock future builds.

sam: /deploybot approve promote rc --id=rc-2026-03-22 --reason "pin last_green due to cache lease deadlock; will rebuild after INF-3120"

deploy-bot: ACK. manual approval recorded. queuing artifact-verify against last_green (no rebuild).

ci-bot: artifact-verify job started, results pending. link: https://ci/internal/verify/7890

ugo: started INF-3120: cache coordinator deadlock on node-cache-7, assigned to infra. will include a mitigation to fail fast if lease acquisition >5s.

vijay: release note blurb: "RC promotion pinned to previously verified build due to remote cache lease deadlock causing CI timeouts; no changes to binary contents; rebuilding planned after cache recovery (INF-3120)."

sam: promote complete once verify green. anyone opposed to blocking auto-promotes until the lease bug fixed?

tess: +1 block auto-promotes for 24h or until INF-3120 resolved. prevents repeat.

deploy-bot: PROMOTE_COMPLETE: rc -> rc-2026-03-22.

ci-bot: artifact-verify passed, canary smoke queued and passing.

ugo: INF-3120 created with runbook: 1) identify stuck writer 2) kill process 3) run lease-recovery 4) scan recent builds for timeouts.

vijay: will draft release note and mark change window status. close thread after INF-3120 ticket number added to Jira.

sam: thanks team — pinned to last-green and proceeding with release window. follow-ups: ticket INF-3120, block auto-promotes, and post-mortem next week.
